title: Truffles Mix - Pack Of 6
descriptionHtml:
Can’t pick a favourite? Don’t. The Truffles Mix brings all six of our truffle flavours together, each in its own tube of 4, so there’s one for every mood (and every person you’re sharing with). Rich dark chocolate shells, nutty, fudgy and caramel centres, 100% clean ingredients and 0% refined sugar.

You’ll get 6 tubes, 24 truffles:

  • 1 x Loca Almond Brownie Truffles (4 pcs)
  • 1 x Dreamy Cashew Caramel Truffles (4 pcs)
  • 1 x OG Peanut Butter Truffles (4 pcs)
  • 1 x Chic Pistachio Truffles (4 pcs)
  • 1 x Showstopper Triple Chocolate Truffles (4 pcs)
  • 1 x Dense Chocolate Fudge Truffles (4 pcs)

Perfect for gifting, sharing at the office, or keeping a stash in the fridge for your 3 p.m. reset.
